ember.name: Ember, Yearly Electricity Data
ember.fields: share = wind share of electricity generation (%); gen = wind generation (TWh); cf = wind generation / (mean of year-end capacities × hours in the year), national average incl. curtailment, blank outside 5–60% or when the previous year-end capacity is under 0.1 GW

population.name: Our World in Data, Population (based on UN World Population Prospects and others)
population.note: per-capita capacity = site year-end capacity / population of the year; after the last population year the last value is carried forward
